about: The rules the services ask the engine as they read a feed (the weather service's model winds, app.gfs; the ingest service's STDDS tracks, ingest.swim; the planner's briefing exposure, app.exposure; the planner as it keeps a live feed or reads a kept one: wingtip.rvr's RVR readings, wingtip.datis's D-ATIS, wingtip.weather's nearest report, wingtip.congested's search for towns, wingtip.traffic's track start), held by the engine (engine/facade/tests/service_rules.rs).

model_wind_levels.about: A GFS level in feet, knots and Celsius: 3,048 m is 10,000 ft (0.3048 m a foot), 10 kt east in m/s blows from the west, 263.15 K is -10 C; no wind at all is from 360; a level with a figure missing is left out

velocity_track.about: A track toward where it goes, degrees true, and its speed; none where it does not move

gairmet_window.about: AIM 7-1-6: the 03Z snapshot stands for 00Z to 06Z, as a hazard at 03 and none at 00 or 06 exists from 0001 to 0559

rvr_readings.about: Hundreds of feet as sent: 35 is 3,500 ft; 60 is the system's most, 6,000 or more (AIM 7-1-13); 00, FF and a blank are no reading

datis_ends.about: A broadcast heard at 0000Z is the airport's until 0200Z: two of AIM 4-1-13's hourly updates

report_near.about: 8.6 nm is under 10 statute miles (8.69 nm), a METAR's vicinity (FAA-H-8083-28B 24.4.3.8.2)

congested_reach.about: At the equator, 2,500 ft (a quarter past 91.119(b)'s 2,000) in degrees of 60 nm: 2500 x 0.3048 / (60 x 1852)

track_left_from.about: A first point 1.5 nm from the field and 400 ft over it is on its takeoff climb (AC 90-66C)
One at pattern altitude, 1,000 ft over the field, is not
